kjv: for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth
mine: for a man made me his servant from my youth
note: Hebrew 'adam hiqnani is from qanah ("acquire"): "a man acquired me", i.e. I have been a bondservant (many emend to "the land has been my possession"); the KJV linked it with miqneh ("cattle").

kjv: What are these wounds in thine hands?
mine: What are these wounds on your chest?
note: Hebrew beyn yadeykha is literally "between your hands", i.e. on the chest or torso (cf. 2 Kgs 9:24); in context these are the self-inflicted cuts of an ecstatic prophet, and "in thine hands" invites a reading as nail wounds.
